# Glossary

- <a id="term-comp"></a>**Comp**: A past sale price from ebay_sold. A comp shows what an item sold for and cannot be bought.
- <a id="term-destination"></a>**Destination**: The country and postcode that offers must reach. The default is AU 4000, Brisbane.
- <a id="term-diagnostic"></a>**Diagnostic**: The entry a marketplace returns when it has no offers. Its diagnostic_code gives the reason.
- <a id="term-forwarder"></a>**Forwarder**: A freight company that receives goods at a warehouse in China and ships them to Australia.
- <a id="term-landed-cost"></a>**Landed cost**: The total in AUD for the requested quantity delivered to the destination postcode.
- <a id="term-lane"></a>**Lane**: The code that searches one marketplace through one hosted API. Each lane returns offers or one diagnostic.
- <a id="term-marketplace"></a>**Marketplace**: A name you pass to search_offers, such as ebay_au or 1688. The server knows 16.
- <a id="term-offer"></a>**Offer**: One listing you can buy, with a price, a delivery status and a landed cost.
